title: Agent Arena: surface backend mutation errors for add/edit property

requirements.summary: Improve Agent Arena add/edit property error handling to show clear English reasons from the backend (especially invalid/missing agent code) instead of generic failure toasts.
acceptanceCriteria: When backend rejects a mutation due to an invalid/missing agent code, the UI displays an English toast/message that clearly instructs the user to return to "/agent" and enter the agent code again.

When backend rejects a mutation for non-authorization reasons (e.g., "Property not found"), the UI displays that reason in English (or a safe, readable normalized equivalent) rather than only "Failed to create property" / "Failed to update property".
The add property flow successfully creates a property and navigates back to "/agent/properties" without showing an error.
The edit property flow successfully updates an existing property and navigates back to "/agent/properties" without showing an error.

file_operations.description: Enhance backend error normalization to extract a clean, readable English reason from common canister/agent error wrappers (e.g., reject/trap prefixes), and keep robust detection of authorization/agent-code failures ("Invalid agent code", "Authorization required", "Unauthorized", etc.) so UI can reliably branch on authorization vs other failures.

Update create/edit submit error handling to use the normalized backend reason and surface it to the user: show the explicit instruction to return to "/agent" and re-enter the agent code on authorization/agent-code failures, and otherwise show the normalized backend reason (falling back only if no readable reason is available) instead of generic "Failed to create/update property" toasts.

Align delete error handling with the same normalized backend reason strategy used for add/edit: on invalid/missing agent code show an English toast instructing return to "/agent" to re-enter the agent code, otherwise display the backend-provided reason when available (to keep Agent Arena mutation failures consistently understandable).
